subject: Invoice delivery: automation token + signed PDF preference and domain whitelist
messages:
From: Marta Sadowska <marta.sadowska@greenline.eu>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: ap@greenline.eu, procurement@greenline.eu
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Invoice delivery preferences / signed attachments

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the onboarding call last week. Our AP team is finalizing the vendor file and we need to lock the invoice delivery details before go-live. A couple of constraints from our side:

- We require invoice attachments to be PGP-signed PDFs (our parser verifies the signature).
- Please include an "invoice_ack_token" (a short string encoded in PDF metadata and as plain-text in the email body) so our reconciliation engine can auto-match the invoice.
- For security we can only accept invoices from whitelisted sender addresses/domains (we'll provide the allowlist).
- We need the VAT number to appear both in the invoice header and in a structured tag (UBL or custom XML element) for tax reporting.

Preferred delivery flow: enroll on your billing portal and push via SFTP/API. However, during the first 4 weeks we need email copies to ap@greenline.eu for manual review.

Could you:
1) Confirm you can PGP-sign PDF invoices and provide the public key/fingerprint?
2) Share the format for the ack token so we can test automated parsing?
3) Confirm the envelope sender you will use so we can whitelist it (we'll add domain and the two specific addresses).

Attaching a sample of our AP parser's expected token format for reference.

Best,
Marta
Accounts Payable
Greenline Analytics

[Attachment: invoice_ack_token_spec.txt (plain text) ]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marta Sadowska <marta.sadowska@greenline.eu>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 13:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences / signed attachments

Hi Marta,

Thanks — this is clear and entirely workable. Short answers up front, then a suggested plan:

1) PGP-signed PDFs: Yes, we can sign attachments with PGP. We will deliver an ASCII-armored detached signature (.asc) or an inline signed PDF depending on your parsing workflow. Fingerprint for our signing key: 3F4A 9C2E 7B1D 5B9F 88AA  0C2E 4D6F 7B21 E5C3 9A2F. If you'd like the public key file we can share it or upload to a keyserver you specify.

2) Ack token format: we propose a 16-char base36 token (e.g. RLW2-9F7K-T3X6) placed in:
   - PDF XMP metadata under dc:identifier,
   - a single-line plaintext header in the email body like "Invoice-Ack-Token: RLW2-9F7K-T3X6",
   - and a short XML element <Redwood:AckToken> in the UBL payload.
I've attached our spec and a small sample schema (invoice_schema_v2.xml) so your parser can validate.

3) Whitelist envelope: we'll send invoices from invoices@redwood.com and redwood-invoices@billing.redwood.com. Domain to whitelist: billing.redwood.com. We recommend allowing both the address and the sending MTA SPF/DKIM fingerprints to reduce false-positives.

Suggested rollout:
- Phase 1 (first 2 invoices): Email copies (PGP-signed PDF + detached .asc) to ap@greenline.eu while we enroll you on the portal.
- Phase 2 (weeks 1-4): Parallel push to SFTP + email copy. We'll include the ack token in both paths.
- Phase 3: Portal/SFTP-only with email fallback if delivery fails.

Attachments: invoice_sample_pgpsigned.pdf.asc (PGP-signed sample), invoice_schema_v2.xml, invoice_ack_token_spec.txt

Next steps for us: Ben will put together the SFTP/API endpoint details and naomi will confirm the signing cadence and sender rotation policy (we sometimes rotate the sender address for multi-entity billing). Can you send the public PGP key you want us to trust, plus the exact allowlist entries you will add?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: invoice_sample_pgpsigned.pdf.asc (ASCII-armored signed PDF sample) ]

Thanks — that all looks good. A few specifics from our side to lock in:

- We'll add billing.redwood.com and invoices@redwood.com to our allowlist; please also provide the sending IP range (we prefer CIDR entries rather than broad domains).
- Our parser wants the detached .asc signature next to the PDF (filename convention: invoice-<YYYYMMDD>-<po>.pdf and invoice-<YYYYMMDD>-<po>.pdf.asc).
- We confirm portal-first but request SFTP endpoint: sftp.greenline.eu:/incoming/redwood (credentials to be exchanged via our vault). Can you push to SFTP or will you require Redwood to pull?
- VAT: confirm your invoice will include both the supplier VAT and the buyer VAT in the structured XML: <AdditionalDocumentReference schemeID="VAT">DE123456789</AdditionalDocumentReference> or similar.

Attached is our public PGP key fingerprint for verification: FP: 78B2 C9D4 2A6F 8E11 5D3C  A7F1 2CED 4491 8F03 AB2C

Timeline: we need the first sample email by Friday so our AP team can test ingestion.

Best,
Marta

- Signing: we'll send PDF + detached .asc as requested. File naming will match invoice-<YYYYMMDD>-<PO>.pdf(.asc).
